userPreferences: Clean architecture, zero empty catch blocks, zero TODO comments in production
Comprehensive test coverage across all domain mutations

scarTissue.lesson: Never use plain password equality or plaintext storage; always use constant-time comparison and bcrypt or argon2id password hashing.
Always require and verify idempotency keys on payment transactions to prevent double charges and race conditions.

scarTissue.pattern: unindexed foreign key joins / N+1 query loops
scarTissue.lesson: Always batch queries and ensure index coverage on foreign keys to prevent full table scans and N+1 query cascades.
Always enforce strict pagination limits (limit/offset or cursor) and validate request payloads with Pydantic/Zod schemas.

mistakes.lesson: Always set explicit, short-lived expiration (exp claim) and validate token signature before decoding.
Always specify column projection and pagination ceiling.

successes.pattern: domain-driven service boundaries with explicit rubrics
successes.lesson: Decomposing complex domain requirements into 7 standard artifacts guarantees zero defect escape and deterministic testing.

conventions.rule: 100% test pass rate and pre-commit gatekeeper 100/100 score required before commit.
All credentials and private keys must be loaded from environment variables, never hardcoded.

anti_patterns.reason: Silently swallows catastrophic exceptions, rendering production failures invisible and un-debuggable.
Opens critical arbitrary remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities.

lessons.lesson: Never provide a default string fallback like 'supersecret' for JWT_SECRET or SECRET_KEY; raise an explicit RuntimeError if missing.
